analyst_view.overall: Torino (10th under Ignazio Abate) have lost two in a row, 3-1 to Como and 2-0 at Frosinone, after three straight wins. Lecce are in a relegation fight and arrive on three straight defeats (0-2 v Juventus, 5-1 at Frosinone, 1-2 v Genoa), with Pierotti, Berisha, Geubbels, Monteiro and Ilic all reported unavailable. Gaspar returns from a two-match ban for Lecce.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.2 goals. Lecce's defence has been leaking (five at Frosinone), but their attack loses Pierotti, Berisha and Geubbels, and Torino have failed to score in their last game. Those two things roughly cancel out, so we see no reason to move off the model.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.1 corners. Both sides are expected in their usual shapes (Torino 3-5-2 with wing-backs, Lecce 4-3-3), and none of the team news points clearly to more or fewer corners.

cards.text: The numbers say 2.1 cards, which looks low for this game. Lecce are in a relegation scrap after three straight defeats, and Torino need a result after two losses, so this could be a tense, scrappy game. Ermanno Feliciani referees.

shots.text: The numbers say 27.1 shots. Torino should have the edge at home with Adams and Simeone up front and Vlasic behind them, while a weakened Lecce attack balances that out. Nothing new points either way.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.4 shots on target. The team news doesn't give a clear reason to move away from the model.
